Messages.Author: Mathieu
Messages.Body:
Can a minion still use Brass Knucles for basic hand damage after using
it for +1HD, thus declaring "weapon strikes" instead of "hand strikes"?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mathieu wrote:
>
> Can a minion still use Brass Knucles for basic hand damage after using
> it for +1HD, thus declaring "weapon strikes" instead of "hand strikes"?

No. Brass Knuckles can only be used once per combat.
